name: Simple-Flag-Secure
description: 👀 Lightweight root module that disables FLAG_SECURE, enabling screenshots & screen recording in restricted apps. Hides screenshot detection on Android 14+. Includes a toggleable privacy mode to block screenshots system-wide. Supports Magisk, KernelSU, APatch & forks with no extra dependencies.
